defs.def: a member of an army, especially one who is not an officer 军人；（尤指）士兵verb

ex.s: Zac knows the meaning of a Purple Heart-he earned one himself in a war as a soldier.
ex.t: 扎克懂得紫心勋章的意义——他作为一名士兵在战争中自己赢得了一枚。

ex.s: He was impressed, saying “.... all the soldiers ___36___ themselves to one idea and worked together to put that idea over.” He then began using the term gung-ho in the Marine Corps to try to create the same spirit he had ___37___.
ex.t: 他印象深刻,说“......所有士兵____36____自己都认同一个想法,并共同努力将这一想法付诸东流。” 然后,他开始使用海军陆战队中的gung-ho一词,试图创造出他拥有的同样____37____精神。

ex.t: 第一次世界大战几个月前就爆发了，但英国和德国士兵放下枪，一起踢足球--在多年的冲突中，这是一个值得记住的和平时刻。

ex.s: The place was the site of a recent battle where thousands of soldiers had died.
ex.t: 这个地方是最近一场战役的所在地,有数千名士兵死亡。

ex.s: The man was Abraham Lincoln, President of the United States of America, and he was there in memory of the soldiers who had died.
ex.t: 那个人是亚伯拉罕\u00b7林肯，美利坚合众国的总统，他到场是为了纪念死去的士兵。
